title: EvidenceAnchor
description: The association between one RelationEvidence record and one external evidence unit. Multiple anchors WITHIN a single RelationEvidence record are CONJUNCTIVE: all of them are jointly required for that evidential basis. `role` MAY indicate a profile-specific function (e.g. 'definition', 'duty', 'observation', 'result') but does NOT alter the default conjunctive semantics.

evidenceUnit.description: The external evidence unit this anchor points to.

selector.description: Optional fragment selector within the evidence unit.

role.description: Optional profile-specific role of this anchor. Does not change conjunctive semantics.

ordinal.description: Optional ordering hint among anchors within the record.
